# 大乘密嚴經疏

**ID:** X0368
**Volume:** X21
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 大小乘釋經部／方等部疏
**Byline:** 唐 法藏撰
**Dynasty:** 唐
**Date:** 618–907
**Juans:** 3
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X0368

## Contributors
- 法藏 (A002450)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

X368 in three fascicles is the principal Tang Chinese commentary on the *Ghanavyūha-sūtra*, attributed in the *Xuzangjing* witness to the great Huáyán (華嚴) systematizer [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) / Fǎzàng (643–712). The commentary follows the chapter structure of *[地婆訶羅's Dàshèng mìyán jīng 大乘密嚴經](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0359)* (T681) — the earlier of the two Chinese versions — and treats the Yogācāra-Tathāgatagarbha doctrinal core (*ālayavijñāna*, three self-natures, *amalavijñāna*, womb-of-the-tathāgata) of the parent sūtra as a seamless extension of Huáyán-school philosophical reading. The witness opens with a *kēwén* 科文 outline and the parenthetical note "卷第一(但逸此卷)" — "fascicle 1 (only this fascicle is missing)" — indicating the first fascicle is lost; what survives is fascicles 2 and 3 plus the original outline.

**Abstract**

The attribution to [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) is internally consistent with the commentary's hexadic Huáyán-style doctrinal classifications and its philological precision in citing both Sanskrit-derived terms and the Yogācāra commentarial corpus. [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) would have written the commentary on [the Divākara version](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0359) (T681, completed 676–688) — composed sometime after 680 (allowing a few years' circulation of the parent sūtra) and before [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F)'s death in 712. The work matters because it provides the only sustained Tang Chinese-language commentary on the *Ghanavyūhasūtra*, a key bridge text between Yogācāra and Tathāgatagarbha doctrine. The commentary reads the *Ghanavyūha* buddhaland not in tantric / esoteric register (as one might in the [Amoghavajra version](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0360) T682) but in the classical Mahāyāna *yīshèng* 一乘 / one-vehicle frame typical of [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F)'s Huáyán synthesis.

The first-fascicle loss removes the commentary on chapter 1 (*Mìyánhuì pǐn* 密嚴會品 — the assembly chapter and *nidāna*-frame); what survives covers the doctrinal interior of the sūtra, including the eight consciousnesses, the *amalavijñāna* doctrine, and the buddhaland descriptions. The commentary is also a key witness for [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F)'s engagement with Yogācāra terminology beyond his better-known Huáyán-internal works (his *Wǔjiào zhāng* 五教章 / [KR6e0035](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0035) etc.). Composition window: 680–712.

Parent sūtra: [KR6i0359](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0359) (T681). Alternate version of parent: [KR6i0360](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0360) (T682).
